# Azure Container Instances — PhotoFrame
# Copy to azure-configurations.txt, fill secrets locally — azure-configurations.txt is gitignored; do not commit.

################################# PHOTOFRAME — AZURE BLOB STORAGE (recommended) #################################

az group create --name PhotoFrame --location southeastasia

az container delete -g PhotoFrame -n photoframe --yes

az container create \
  --resource-group PhotoFrame \
  --name photoframe \
  --image ghcr.io/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME/photoframe:main \
  --ip-address Public \
  --dns-name-label photoframe \
  --ports 8082 \
  --location southeastasia \
  --os-type Linux \
  --cpu 1 \
  --memory 2.0 \
  --restart-policy Always \
  --registry-login-server ghcr.io \
  --registry-username "YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME" \
  --registry-password "YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN_WITH_read:packages" \
  --environment-variables \
      PHOTOFRAME_HOME=/app \
      SERVER_PORT=8082 \
      LOGGING_FILE_NAME=/app/logs/photoframe.log \
      LOG_LEVEL=INFO \
      PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_PROVIDER=azure \
      PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_AZURE_CONTAINER=photoframe \
      PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_GOOGLE_PREFIX=google-photos-cache \
      PHOTOFRAME_GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS=/app/google-photos-credentials.properties \
      PHOTOFRAME_GOOGLE_PICKED_FILE=/app/google-photos-picked.json \
      PHOTOFRAME_DISPLAY_SETTINGS=/app/slideshow-display.json \
      photoframe.source=google \
      GOOGLE_PHOTOS_CLIENT_ID="YOUR_CLIENT_ID" \
  --secure-environment-variables \
      AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING="YOUR_AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING" \
      GOOGLE_PHOTOS_CLIENT_SECRET="YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET" \
      GOOGLE_PHOTOS_REFRESH_TOKEN="YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN"

# URL: http://photoframe.southeastasia.azurecontainer.io:8082/

################################# PHOTOFRAME — FILESYSTEM STORAGE (ephemeral /app/data) #################################

az container create \
  --resource-group PhotoFrame \
  --name photoframe \
  --image ghcr.io/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME/photoframe:main \
  --ip-address Public \
  --dns-name-label photoframe \
  --ports 8082 \
  --location southeastasia \
  --os-type Linux \
  --cpu 1 \
  --memory 2.0 \
  --restart-policy Always \
  --registry-login-server ghcr.io \
  --registry-username "YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME" \
  --registry-password "YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN" \
  --environment-variables \
      PHOTOFRAME_HOME=/app \
      PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_PROVIDER=filesystem \
      PHOTOFRAME_STORAGE_ROOT=/app/data \
      SERVER_PORT=8082 \
      LOGGING_FILE_NAME=/app/logs/photoframe.log \
      LOG_LEVEL=INFO \
      photoframe.source=google \
  --secure-environment-variables \
      GOOGLE_PHOTOS_CLIENT_SECRET="YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET" \
      GOOGLE_PHOTOS_REFRESH_TOKEN="YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN"
